name: game-create
description: Multi-agent web-game creation workflow. Collects a game brief, designs a small front-end game, reviews it as a player, designs its screens with Stitch, fans out parallel module developers, integrates them into one runnable game, runs one full QA pass, repairs failures in bounded rounds, then serves it on a local HTTP server and hands back the URL. Use when asked to "make a game", "做个游戏", "写个小游戏", "game demo", or "游戏创作".
